title: ACI Worldwide to Add Microservices Card Switching to ACI Connetic for Cards via Acquisition of Cranium Ventures
summary: OMAHA, Neb., September 01, 2026--ACI Worldwide (NASDAQ: ACIW), an original innovator in global payments technology, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Cranium Ventures, a privately held developer of cloud-native card payment switching technology. The technology will be added to ACI Connetic for Cards, which ACI launched in March 2026.
